summary_rationale: Price-blind fundamental audit confirms Adobe Inc. (ADBE) is an elite, high-ROIC software compounder (COMPOUNDER_PASS): across FY2016–FY2025, revenue quadrupled from $5,854M to $23,769M (16.9% 9-year CAGR) and accelerated +12.5% YoY in 9M FY2026 ($19,776M), supported by 96%–97% recurring subscription revenue, 89.3% gross margins, 36.6% FY2025 GAAP operating margins, 41.4% FCF margins ($9,852M FCF; $10,592M LTM), 33.3% true FCF ex-SBC margins ($7,910M FY2025; $8,521M LTM), 50%+ operating ROIC, and a 21.6% 10-year diluted share-count reduction (504M to 395M). Proprietary file standards (.PSD/.AI/.INDD/.PDF), commercially indemnified multi-model Firefly AI, a 1B+ MAU distribution funnel, and the end-to-end enterprise content supply chain (Creative Cloud + GenStudio + AEP + Semrush) remain durable moats. However, kpi_health is set to PASS_WITH_WATCH due to five active transitional watch items: (1) Q3 FY2026's first-ever Q2-to-Q3 sequential RPO decline (-$110M to $22.16B, +8.4% YoY) and -$46M deferred-revenue cash-flow swing; (2) the June 2026 pivot to freemium user acquisition and deferred Creative Cloud price hikes, leaving a steep ~$777M implied Q4 net new ARR hurdle to hit the 10.2% FY2026 target; (3) AI-first ARR (>$650M, +150% YoY) still representing only ~2.4% of $27.50B Total ARR while Canva (including free Affinity), Figma, and generative AI upstarts test prosumer pricing power; (4) ~150–230 bps YoY operating margin compression in Q3 FY2026 (GAAP 34.8%, Non-GAAP 44.0%) as Subscription COGS (+24% YoY on AI inference/hosting), R&D (+18%), and G&A (+20%) rose faster than revenue; and (5) simultaneous C-suite turnover (CEO Anil Chakravarthy succeeding Shantanu Narayen on Dec 1, 2026; interim CFO Steve Day following Dan Durn's June 2026 departure) alongside the March 2026 $150M DOJ/FTC ROSCA settlement.
